nodes.summary: Chargebee is a comprehensive subscription management and recurring billing platform that enables businesses to automate their quote-to-cash processes, manage customer churn, and gain insights on revenue. It offers seamless integration with various business tools, reducing maintenance costs and enhancing customer satisfaction.

nodes.name: Subscription Management
nodes.description: Allows businesses to manage and automate their subscription billing processes.

nodes.name: Revenue Recognition
nodes.description: Helps businesses recognize revenue accurately and be GAAP-compliant and audit ready.

nodes.name: Customer Retention
nodes.description: Predicts churn, deflects cancellation attempts, and grows customer lifetime value.

nodes.name: Reporting and Analytics
nodes.description: Provides insights on revenue and other key business metrics.

nodes.name: Payment Retries and Collections
nodes.description: Automates the process of retrying failed payments and collecting due amounts.

nodes.name: Integration Capabilities
nodes.description: Offers seamless integration with various business tools and payment gateways.

nodes.name: Security & Compliance
nodes.description: Ensures the platform is secure and compliant with relevant regulations.
